projects.title: TJs Reisedagbok✈️
projects.description: My travel blog that I originally developed for my exchange semester in Australia, Melbourne. I upload posts and pictures from my travels and users can sign in to like posts. This website uses Google Firebase, Sanity and tailwindCSS in React.

projects.title: Photo Wall🎞️
projects.description: Photo Wall, a website where anyone can upload photos to share. This website is built in React, tailwindCSS and Sanity for CMS.

projects.title: Programming Language
projects.description: Me and Vetle Knutsen created our own programing language CA$H with ANTLR. Created an interpreter and compiler in the special course DAT259 at HVL.

projects.title: echo Webkom👩🏽‍💻
projects.description: Webkom is a sub-group of our student association under the Department of Informatics at University in Bergen. Webkom runs the student association's websites.
